Title: Register with valid details
Preconditions: User is on the registration page
Steps:
1. Enter the full name
2. Enter the email
3. Enter the password
4. Confirm the password
5. Tick the Terms checkbox
6. Click Register
Expected Result: The user is redirected to the welcome page; The message 'Registration successful' is displayed

Title: Registration fails when the email is already registered
Preconditions: User is on the registration page
Steps:
1. Enter the full name
2. Enter an already registered email
3. Enter and confirm the password
4. Tick the Terms checkbox
5. Click Register
Expected Result: The error 'Email already registered' is displayed; The user stays on the registration page

Title: Mismatched passwords show an error
Preconditions: User is on the registration page
Steps:
1. Enter the password
2. Enter a different value in Confirm password
3. Click Register
Expected Result: The error 'Passwords do not match' is displayed next to the Confirm password field

Title: A short password is rejected
Preconditions: User is on the registration page
Expected Result: The error 'Password must be at least 8 characters' is displayed

Title: Empty required fields show validation errors
Preconditions: User is on the registration page
Steps:
1. Leave all fields empty
2. Click Register
Expected Result: The error 'Name is required' is displayed; The error 'Email is required' is displayed; The error 'Password is required' is displayed

Title: Register button stays disabled until Terms are accepted
Preconditions: User is on the registration page
Steps:
1. Observe the Register button
2. Tick the Terms checkbox
Expected Result: The Register button is disabled before the checkbox is ticked; The Register button is enabled after the checkbox is ticked

Title: Registration page looks right
Preconditions: User is on the registration page

Title: Show or hide the password
Preconditions: User is on the registration page
Steps:
1. Enter a password
2. Click the show password icon
